evidence.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?

summary: Researchers have released the SWE Refactor Bench, a benchmark designed to test whether AI coding agents can perform long‑horizon, whole‑repository refactoring tasks such as stack migrations. The suite measures agents’ ability to understand, modify, and verify large codebases, aiming to drive progress in autonomous software engineering.
title: New SWE Refactor Bench Evaluates Coding Agents on Whole‑Repository Stack Migrations
